description: Publish a community entry AS YOURSELF — owned by your own user in the app (the app user whose email is your developer email; log into the app once first). Use it to seed a community with starter content. It skips the review queue (you are a moderator of your app) and obeys the same rules as neblla.community.publish: community must be enabled, contentType/category must be allowed, payload ≤ maxPayloadBytes, no "$"/"." keys.

contentType.description: One of the app's community.contentTypes (any when the list is empty)

parentId.description: Id of the entry this one derives from

payload.description: The dev-defined JSON the app stores for this entry

name: neblla_publish_community_entry
